title: Enterprise Connectivity: excluded incident causes
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following excluded incident causes for each named contract tier. Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | excluded incident causes | customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the excluded incident causes is customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream-customer incident.
